name: sdlc-workflow
description: One command, `/wf` (`$wf` under Codex), the single SDLC entry point for Claude Code and Codex from one plugin tree. It drives 9 stages, from intake through retro, with per-slice artifacts, runtime-truth verification and PO-confirmed stack fingerprinting. 18 keys: intake, shape, design, slice, plan, implement, verify, review, handoff, ship, retro, probe, yolo, campaign, loop, status, project, docs. Quick and standalone flows are `/wf intake` modes: `fix`, `rca`, `investigate`, `discover`, `audit`, `hotfix`, `refactor`, `update-deps`, `ideate`, `brainstorm`, `adopt`, `optimize`, `simplify`, `task`.
